blocks.tamil_translation: he does, and another ring comes loose (and so, as he keeps doing good deeds, the rings keep coming loose), until in the end all the rings come loose and it falls to the ground." Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The one who sins becomes bound by his sins and loses his peace; through good deeds the bonds of the sins come loose and his anxiety leaves him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَا ظَهَرَ الْغُلُولُ فِي قَوْمٍ قَطُّ إِلَّا أُلْقِيَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبُ، وَلَا فَشَي الزِّنَا فِي قَوْمٍ قَطُّ إِلَّا كَثُرَ فِيهِمُ الْمَوْتُ، وَلَا نَقَصَ قَوْمٌ الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ إِلَّا قُطِعَ عَنْهُمُ الرِّزْقُ، وَلَا حَكَمَ قَوْمٌ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ إِلَّا فَشَي فِيهِمُ الدَّمُ، وَلَا خَتَرَ قَوْمٌ بِالْعَهْدِ إِلَّا سُلِّطَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَدُوُّ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الامام مالك في الموطا باب ما جاء في الغلول ص:٤٧٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: "In whichever community open fraud takes place in the Ghanimah (spoils), terror of the enemy will be cast into their hearts; in whichever community adultery becomes widespread, death will increase among them; whichever community gives short measure and short weight, their sustenance will be taken away — the needs of that community will go unfulfilled; whichever community commits injustice in giving judgment, bloodshed will increase among them; whichever community breaks its covenant, enemies will be set over them."

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَجُلاً يَقُوْلُ: إِنَّ الظَّالِمَ لَاَ يَضُرُّ إِلَّا نَفْسَهُ، فَقَالَ أَبُوْهُرَيْرَةَ ﵁: بَلَي وَاللهِ حَتَّي الْحُبَارَي لَتَمُوْتُ فيِ
